decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program supports the firm's fast-response service position and is still marketed, although it could be folded into broader express offerings if overlap grows.

The seventy-two-hour express offer matches the firm's differentiation through speed and low downtime, but its operational intensity and likely narrower demand make it the most vulnerable of the current products.
A dedicated page in both years and a multi-model line suggest this express doors-and-gates program has become an important extension of the core business.
The online ordering and digital services platform strengthens advisory and service integration, which fits the firm's direction and is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
The fire and smoke protection door gained prominence from a mention to its own page, indicating growing strategic relevance in a safety-driven market.
